artillery_window_requirements: State from where and when the selected output can hit artillery, real range/contact assumptions, expected hits, and a kill point; mark uncertain targeting/contact as assumptions.
Account for every shell as cast selection, projectile birth lock, delayed hit, splash radius, co-hit risk, treatment competition and attack cooldown.
If rotation is used, retreat must occur while the unit is alive; death has no refund. Name the live successor and check blocking/output vacancy.
Do not trade central #21/#22, #28/#31/#34 or protected-target clearance for an isolated artillery kill.
